digest.component_or_area: reconciler dispatch, eval runner, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry is declared but never read, causing caller-supplied timeout_s values intended for the wrapped Jira client to be swallowed instead of forwarded through **kwargs
run_eval signature accepts dirty parameter that is never read and no caller passes it

module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metric specs are registered with permanent _no_data_yet compute functions that always return Unavailable, creating a latent trap where a future real implementation would be silently skipped due to id collision in the registration conditional
test_trend_unavailable test pins a stubbed metric in place and must be removed with its corresponding specs
